decisions.reason: A large bulk container builds directly on the firm's core plastics moulding knowledge, so management can read early market signals and improve the product with its own R&D, and its dedicated web page signals strategic commitment.
The valve is a closely related component of the firm's container systems, draws on existing engineering competence and complements Product A, so the firm can readily absorb feedback and refine it.

A take-back service is less related to the firm's manufacturing knowledge and is only mentioned on the website, but it fits circular-economy and German packaging-regulation pressures and supports the container business, so management will likely keep it while learning.
